value.rationale: This result separates three physically distinct positivity regimes on a canonical high-dimensional diffusion network, gives the exact sharp timestep cutoff for the natural eight-vertex cube, and proves a structural long-step obstruction for all higher cubes. It prevents interpreting A-stability as stochasticity and identifies a surprising small-step failure onset at dimension seven. The precise quartic and sharp boundaries are motivated by timestep selection, not arbitrary parameter slicing.
